The '''Smugglers Guild''' was a short-lived criminal organization in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="u">{{LivingForce|Between the Worlds: UnderWorld}}</ref>

In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], members of [[The Cell]] under the orders of (probably) [[Ari Melast]] began a scheme to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nirama]], replace him and reinstate [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. They began using the name "Smugglers Guild" before having actually killed Nirama or his top men.<ref name="u" />

The murder plot failed, the guilty parts were quickly identified and taken care of, and Nirama kept the power on the system.<ref name="u" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Smugglers Guild had apparently reformed or reorganized. Still involved with slavery, representatives of the Smugglers Guild placed a bid for the people of [[Kiros/Legends|Kiros]] at the [[Royal Slave Auction/Legends|Royal Slave Auction]] on [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. Their eight and a half million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] bid was the high bid until the auction was disrupted by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]].<ref name="sotr" />
